name: myotgo-food
description: Order food for delivery or collection, find restaurants near you, see menus with photos and declared allergens, and book tables. You pay in the MyOTgo app.

interface.longDescription:
MyOTgo Food lets your assistant do what you do in the MyOTgo Food app, with your account.

- Orders food for delivery or collection: it builds the order in your basket and you pay in MyOTgo.
- Finds restaurants near the address you confirm, with photos, ratings, opening hours, delivery fees and whether they deliver to you.
- Shows menus with food photos and the allergens and diet marks each restaurant has declared (never guessed).
- Books tables, and changes or cancels your bookings.
- Fills your MyOTgo basket and applies your vouchers, credit or points, delivery time and notes.
- Reorders past meals, tracks orders, reports a problem, writes your review and emails receipts.

Clear basket additions happen straight away in your editable basket; unclear sizes or options, another restaurant's basket, large quantities and other protected changes are shown first for you to confirm. It never asks for or uses health information such as allergies or diets, and never sees card details. It never pays: when your basket is ready you get one secure link to check the summary and pay in MyOTgo. It can never delete your account or change your password, email or two-step sign-in.

Available everywhere ChatGPT is; the restaurants on MyOTgo are currently in the United Kingdom.
capabilities: Find restaurants that deliver to your confirmed address
Menus with photos and declared allergens and diets
Book, change and cancel table bookings
Fill your MyOTgo basket and hand over to pay in the app
Reorder, track orders, review and email receipts
defaultPrompt: Find a pizza place that delivers to my home address
Book a table for 4 tomorrow at 7pm nearby

positive.description: Find restaurants for a confirmed saved address
positive.prompt: Find a pizza place that delivers to my home address
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes the saved Home address and asks to confirm it, then shows restaurant cards with photo, rating, distance and whether each delivers there.

positive.prompt: What vegetarian dishes does MyOTgo Demo Pizzeria have, and do any contain nuts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the vegetarian dishes with photos and prices, gives only the restaurant's declared allergen information, says when something is not declared, and adds the note to check with the restaurant.

positive.prompt: Add two Margherita pizzas from MyOTgo Demo Pizzeria to my basket for collection
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of the basket change, asks to confirm, then adds the items and shows the basket summary. Nothing is ordered or paid.

positive.description: Hand over to pay in the app
positive.prompt: My basket is ready, how do I pay?
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation returns one secure link to review and pay in MyOTgo, and says no order has been placed or paid in the chat.

positive.prompt: Book a table for 4 at MyOTgo Demo Pizzeria tomorrow at 7pm
positive.expected_behavior: Checks availability, shows the booking details to confirm, then books with the account's name and phone and shows the booking confirmation card.

negative.prompt: Pay for my basket with my saved card now
Show me the orders of the customer at 12 High Street

review.commerce_description: The assistant builds the customer's MyOTgo basket and applies their own vouchers, credit or points. It never takes payment: the customer reviews the summary and pays in the MyOTgo app or website through a single-use link.
